titre: Disabled child education allowance (AEEH) and the MDPH de Mayotte
resume: Putting together a complete MDPH file for the AEEH, then paid by the CSSM: 2026-2027 amounts in Mayotte, medical certificate less than a year old, response times and appeals.
aQuoiCaSert: The AEEH (allocation d'éducation de l'enfant handicapé, disabled child education allowance) helps parents cover the education and care costs of a child with a disability. It consists of a basic amount and, depending on needs, a supplement and an increase for single parents. You apply to the MDPH (maison départementale des personnes handicapées, the local disability services center). The CDAPH (commission des droits et de l'autonomie, the rights and autonomy committee) decides, then the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund) pays the allowance and informs you of its amount.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of a child under 20 with a disability rate of at least 80%.
Parents of a child with a rate from 50% to under 80%, if the child attends a specialized facility or service or if care is recommended by the CDAPH.
Separated parents, whatever the child's residence arrangement (the AEEH is paid to only one parent).
aSavoir: Amounts in Mayotte from April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027 (CSSM): basic amount of €153.01 per month, with no income conditions.
Increase for single parents, from level 2: €62.16 (2), €86.07 (3), €272.55 (4), €349.06 (5), €511.63 (6) per month.
The medical certificate (cerfa n° 15695) must be no more than one year old when you submit the file.
The CDAPH must reply within 4 months. With no reply after 4 months, the application is considered rejected.

If refused, a mandatory prior administrative appeal (recours administratif préalable obligatoire) can be made within 2 months, then an appeal to the tribunal judiciaire (judicial court) within 2 months of the reply.
The application form is available from the MDPH, from the CCAS (centre communal d'action sociale, municipal social welfare center) of your town or online.

Photocopy. If you are housed by someone, add a statement from the person housing you.

documents.detail: Keep it: it starts the 4-month period.

etapes.titre: Make an appointment with the doctor for the medical certificate
etapes.detail: The certificate must be less than a year old when you submit. Ask the doctor to detail the child's everyday needs.
Describe the child's life, needs, schooling and your expenses.
Signed form, original medical certificate less than a year old, IDs of the child and legal representatives, proof of address, assessments. An incomplete file delays the review.

etapes.titre: Submit the file to the MDPH or the CCAS
etapes.detail: Or send it, preferably by registered letter with acknowledgment of receipt. Keep a full copy.
The CDAPH has 4 months to reply. Note the date so you can follow up and, if refused, appeal within 2 months.
